name: 2CRSI S.A.
summary: 2CRSI S.A., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and distributes end-to-end computing solutions in France and internationally. The company offers servers, such as GPU and AI servers, mainstream compute servers, high density servers, rugged servers, and accessories and risers; rack solutions; and workstations comprising high performance workstations, rugged fanless computers, and microclusters. It also provides air, direct liquid, and immersion cooling solutions; data science, as well as AI, ML, and DL HPC solutions; cloud solutions, computing, and gaming; and edge computing solutions. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Strasbourg, France.
